title: Pro Shinan Mahjong: Tsuwamono
overview:
Pro Play That Will Fire You Up

For mahjong game fans: the perfect chance to learn how the pros play!

Among the many mahjong games said to be the real thing, this Pro Shinan Mahjong Tsuwamono has succeeded in developing advanced artificial intelligence, faithfully reproducing every move of professional players who have conquered numerous big titles. It also includes an instruction mode where pros coach you kindly and thoroughly. Be sure to master the pros' techniques.

君を熱くするプロの打ち筋

麻雀ゲームファンに贈るプロの打ち筋を学ぶ絶好のチャンス！

本物と言われている数多くの麻雀ゲームの中で、このプロ指南麻雀兵は高度の人工知能開発に成功し、数々のビックタイトルを制覇したプロ雀士の一手一手を見事に実現。しかもプロが親切丁寧に指導してくれる指南モードも搭載。プロの技を是非修得してください。
